notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Alberta register row and one Alberta program page were found; no Adair-specific history, agency page or news was located in two searches. The story gives only the construction year, height, elevation and status. Brief access closed is corrected to restricted because the register lists the tower as active with fly-in access. Brief agency Alberta Wildfire is not stated in the fetched register row and is left out of facts.
